provenance: Hand-authored flat-FOND miniature (ticket fond-htn-06-diff-flatfond, 2026-09-17). One fault bit is probed; BOTH probe outcomes are recoverable by a distinct deterministic log action — the AND-semantics all-outcomes-acceptable shape of a strong plan (Cimatti, Pistore, Roveri & Traverso, AIJ 2003). No koala files used.
literature_ref: Cimatti, Pistore, Roveri, Traverso, 'Weak, Strong, and Strong Cyclic Planning via Symbolic Model Checking', AIJ 147 (2003)
class_rationale: probe's two outcomes lead to bit-0/bit-1 states, each completable by its own deterministic log action with no loops: an acyclic strong policy exists.
